title: Members of Bolden's band: Mumford, bass player, Cornish
summary: Jones recalls Mumford (guitar, nicknamed Brock), a bass player named Jimmy, and Willie Cornish, Bolden's trombone player, and suggests looking in the Cherokee and Ann neighborhood.
